responsibility: Implements gm2’s bookkeeping and validation for case alternatives and variant-record label sets. It builds stacked `CaseDescriptor` and `CaseList` structures with stored constant/range pairs, checks that bounds are declared and GCC-resolved, detects overlapping ranges, verifies tag-type compatibility and range inclusion, computes missing enumeration or variant alternatives when no `ELSE` is present, and emits detailed diagnostics via `M2MetaError`.
same_name_distinction: This `.mod` file is the implementation side of M2CaseList: it defines the internal `CaseDescriptor`, `CaseList`, and range/conflict bookkeeping structures and performs overlap, type, and missing-alternative checks with emitted diagnostics, unlike `M2CaseList.def` which only publishes the callable interface.
